_about: Farm guard profiles, read by rtse/farmguard.py. Object names were read from the game's own files (localization .int/.deu sections and GUID caches). What each step does to the farm comes from community farm notes and has NOT been checked in a live game.

profiles.name: Wildlife Exploitation Preserve loot midgets
profiles.description: During Doctor's Orders, each slag-experiment recorder you pick up lowers the number of the best loot midget spawns. Leave the recorders where they are and reload the map to farm.

consequence.objective: Picking up this recorder would reduce the midget spawns.
consequence.status: Changing the state of Doctor's Orders can end the loot midget farm.
consequence.complete: Turning in Doctor's Orders ends the loot midget farm.
consequence.pickup: Picking up this recorder would reduce the midget spawns.

unverified: How many recorders there are, and how many midgets each one costs.
That putting the objective count back brings the midgets back after a reload.

profiles.name: Space Cowboy porta-potty loot midget
profiles.area: Commander Lilith & the Fight for Sanctuary
profiles.dlc: Commander Lilith & the Fight for Sanctuary
profiles.description: Space Cowboy has a loot midget hiding in a porta-potty (IO_ToiletMidget). It only shows up while the mission is at the right step. RTSE guards every step, because which one ends the farm hasn't been checked in game.

consequence.objective: Advancing Space Cowboy could stop the porta-potty loot midget from appearing.
consequence.status: Changing the state of Space Cowboy could stop the porta-potty loot midget from appearing.
consequence.complete: Turning in Space Cowboy ends the porta-potty loot midget farm.
consequence.pickup: Picking this up advances Space Cowboy and could stop the porta-potty loot midget from appearing.

unverified: Which step of Space Cowboy ends the porta-potty midget (every step is guarded until that's known).
Which map the porta-potty is on.
